newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Defiance rejects higher Bunge bid-chairman.
newsitem.headline: Defiance rejects higher Bunge bid-chairman.

text.p: Defiance Mills Ltd Chairman Tom O'Brien said on Wednesday the board of Defiance would recommend shareholders reject Bunge Corp's revised takeover bid of A$1.95 a share.

"The board of Defiance is still advising that the price is nowhere near high enough," O'Brien told Reuters after Bunge's announcement it had raised its bid and secured acceptances from Defiance's major shareholder, the O'Brien-family controlled Defiance Holdings Ltd.
O'Brien said he was disappointed by Defiance Holdings' acceptance and had not been consulted on the revised bid.
